exec git init -b main
at 2026-07-21T12:00:00Z
exec card init --prefix producer-
exec card config set --scope store issue.id.strategy sequential

exec card apply catalog-source.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/created.txt

# A rejected document leaves both the existing issue and allocator unchanged.
! exec card apply rejected-refresh.json
cmp stderr $WORK/golden/rejected.txt
exec card --json show producer-1
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/source.json

exec card apply resume-refresh.json
cmp stdout $WORK/golden/resumed.txt
exec card --json show producer-2
cmpjson stdout $WORK/golden/verification.json
